_note: Errands: safe idle jobs you put resting pets on (the errands tab, opened by the little basket). Nobody is ever lost on an errand. Every job works the same way: a meter fills once every 'seconds' with one pet, faster with more (crew size ^ 'crew_power', so each extra pet helps a little less and spreading pets out beats stacking them), and pays 'pay' each time it's full. A pet's 'stat' nudges how fast it works (rarer pets have higher stats, see Jobs.pet_speed), and 'traits' multiply it. 'part': a common part each fill; 'uncommon' gives a chance of an uncommon part once the crew is big enough. Errands never bring rare parts or new places: those only come from adventures. Offline they run at full speed for 'offline_full_hours', then at 'offline_after' speed. 'color' is a UiTheme role, 'doodle' a UiTheme doodle. 'coming' is the locked note for the next job.
